scope: Each breakage is applied alone to a real source file, the verifier that should catch it is run for real, the file is restored and the restore is checked byte-identical by SHA-256. A breakage that leaves its verifier green is a SURVIVOR and means the guard does not work.
limitations: The browser layer runs only with INCLUDE_BROWSER=1 against a running preview; without it those four breakages are not applied at all and are not counted.
A caught breakage that cites a different assertion is reported as such rather than counted as a clean catch; the citation is a substring match on the failure text.
